svg.data-power-without-attachments: 17 W (brochure and product page, without attachments)
svg.data-power-input: DC jack 12 - 57 V, or PoE in on Ethernet 1, 18 - 57 V. The quick guide says 11 - 57 V for the jack; the rear prints DC 12-57 V
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: brochure: the eight SFP+ slots support up to 10 Gbit modules, none included
